title: The CCMS and Land Office check interface, the harness environment and seeding set, the fake response values and the evidence and gate of the early readiness harness are not in the sources
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (RWB-E3-013); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3.md (FEAT-TRT-13, FEAT-TRT-12); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Business Requirements Program v4.md; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4.md (R-DIL-01, R-SET-22); 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1.md
description: No source names the early encumbrance and title check interface the Workbench uses with CCMS and the Land Office, its codes, its transport or layout, its test endpoint or the fixture result codes; nor the harness repository and its SIT environment; nor the seeding set that places the case at ROUTE_APPROVED_DIL with its deed-in-lieu treatment and the second case at COLLATERAL_RELEASE_REQUESTED with its title documents missing, including the identifiers of the cases, the treatments and the accounts; nor the exact response values of the six fakes of section 12.8; nor the evidence report format and its retention; nor the pass or fail gate the wave entry check reads.
evidence: RWB-E3-013 gives one endpoint (GET /api/recovery/v1/treatments/{treatmentId}), four screens of state names and six messages, and no interface detail; FEAT-TRT-13 names CCMS and the Land Office as the systems and gives no operation, code or layout; the Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-DIL-01 and R-SET-22 give the from state, the event, the condition, the action, the to state, the owner, the systems and the timer and no protocol; Architecture v5 slide 41 gives the service catalogue and its topics, and slide 14, 15 and 18 give the P3, P1, P7, P4 and S2 contracts, and no check interface; the ownership map gives no CCMS or Land Office operation and no harness operation.
proposed: Name one check interface with its codes and its fixture result set; fix one SIT harness environment and its repository; publish one seeding set of two cases with their treatments, accounts and asset keys and the exact response values of the six fakes; fix the evidence report shape, its retention and one pass or fail gate keyed by story and business date; keep every value in configuration, never in code.
